title: Sprint planning runs a speed goal's premise as a measure of how much of the work the mechanism reaches
goal: A committed story whose goal promises a wall-time or request saving from a mechanism (a map, a cache, a signal) has as its premise a count of the sources the mechanism reaches today, recorded before the start gate; answers SP-ilje65fa, where ST-v3pruppq promised a shorter detect run by LEARN_MAP and found after the work that the map reaches 140 of 1388 Learn sources, so the wall time did not fall.
